unit_title: Taking Care of My Own Space
standards: Manuel Academy Ready for Life elementary sequence — Grade 3
Ready for Life v1 safety, supervision, and no-shame policy reference
Michigan Health/SEL connections
Manuel Academy RFL G3 Unit 1 — personal and shared space care

prompts.prompt: Explain why our spaces matter in your own words and give or identify one valid example.
Use a drawing, chart, checklist, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of the five-minute tidy.
Apply everything has a home in a new realistic situation. Show the steps or give the evidence.
Analyze a plausible mistake, unsafe step, or weak claim involving spotting unsafe items; correct it and explain why the correction is better.
Connect why our spaces matter with finishing the whole job. Explain how the two ideas support or depend on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit project: Plan, do, and check a five-minute tidy in one shared space with a trusted adult nearby, then record the finished loop on a no-shame checklist.
Name one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy or safety, and one next question.

mastery_interpretation.secure: At least 85% with accurate independent application and adequate evidence or reasoning.
mastery_interpretation.developing: 70–84% or inconsistent explanation; assign targeted review and a fresh transfer check.
mastery_interpretation.not_yet: Below 70% or a missing prerequisite; reteach the smallest gap and reassess with new evidence.
mastery_interpretation.rule: A unit score is one evidence source, not the sole basis for long-term mastery.

evidence_note: Performance evidence for a real-world household task requires the guardian confirmation described in the course study integration; a learner self-report alone does not certify it.
